phase3_findings.description: The final-byte refund decrements final_byte_passes_used, which is a _ROUND_BUDGETS member feeding _funded_rounds; the round the grant paid for stays in doc['rounds'], so the refund retracts funding for an already-opened round and the replacement dispatch is hard-refused as unfunded. Falsifies AC85 and the 'no offer fires that an accepted round could not honour' invariant.
The refund clears final_byte_slot_digest unconditionally, discarding a spend recorded for different bytes when a later offer moved the slot on before an older round closed.

final_byte_passes' docstring names 'the producer's ceiling refusal' as a consumer, but cmd_record_final_byte_offer open-coded the comparison; and final_byte_slot_unspent's 'every other mention points at it' was contradicted by the producer restating both terms inline.

'unestablished on exactly three states, complete by construction' is false — the derivation has a fourth arm (state-unestablished, also the foreign-nonce route). Mirrored in DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md and the cutover doc.
The two new illegal-transition rows declare reason tokens no breadcrumb emits, unlike the #562 precedent whose message embeds its token.
_row792_absent_round_digest would FAIL: _validate already refuses an attempt with a missing digest, so the state collapses to None and the axis answers unestablished, never uncovered.
The AC85 refund row asserted the counter and the trigger but never that the refunded pass is dispatchable — the guarantee AC85 states. It would have shipped the Critical green.
AC89's attestation row recorded a mismatch (whole file vs the body-only comparand), never the `match` the criterion names, and asserted nothing about the status.
The calibration half of the selector-exclusion row was vacuous (unestablished on both sides), and AC111's FILE-pass variant was not driven.
No embed-arm row existed, leaving the arm=='file' term of _final_byte_round unasserted — replacing the selector with last_completed would have left every row green.
The undigestible-draft arm (AC93 term 2) and the producer's two digest refusals had no assertion.
AC125's backward-compatibility row ran the POST-change _validate over the new keys, proving nothing about the prior build.
AC112 (post-adjudication fields report the pass's own record) and AC109 (pass -> FILE -> one more edit -> uncovered again and offerable) had no rows.

cmd_record_creation_epoch is a digest-reading site not routed through resolve_draft_digest, so the resolver's 'single owner of the precedence rule every digest-reading surface obeys' docstring overstated the tree.
AC105 substitutes _ARMS for the file-arm/embed-arm out-of-bounds enumerations it names; those are count-locked prose lists in skills/create-issue/references/, not module constants.
The change adds no surface-presence pins to lib/test/modules/create-issue-contract.sh, so the new prose contracts are unguarded against silent reversion.

fix_decisions.claim_text: AC105 substitutes _ARMS for the out-of-bounds enumerations it names
fix_decisions.evidence: the named enumerations are count-locked prose lists in skills/create-issue/references/, which this change does not touch; the assertion was reworded to name what it pins and to disclose the residual as evidenced by the diff rather than by the row

parking_evidence.basis: the finding is correct that _ARMS is a different constant; the deliverable is a disclosure rather than a new prose pin, because the operator instruction for this run defers new existence-only pins (see issue #798)
parking_evidence.failing_input: a change that edited an out-of-bounds enumeration would not be caught by this row

fix_decisions.claim_text: the change adds no surface-presence pins over the new prose contracts
fix_decisions.evidence: the operator instruction for this run is to skip test runs because ~99% of pin tests are being deprecated (issue #798); adding new existence-only pins would grow exactly the pool that issue exists to retire. The issue's Implementation Notes (non-authoritative narrative) name these pins; no acceptance criterion requires them.

parking_evidence.failing_input: a silent revert of the new prose contracts would not turn the suite RED
